column3:
Due to DTB Group’s operations being regionally focused, the Bank is currently not classified
as a Globally Systemically Important Bank (GSIB) under the Basel Committee on Banking
Supervision (BCBS) methodology. There are current cross-jurisdictional and size complexity
factors that restrict the Bank from being classified to get a GSIB score.
